decisions.reason: As a single 2018 compilation CD, its market test has largely had time to resolve and the firm can reallocate shelf space and attention to newer niche releases if demand proved only modest.

Because this is a multi-model illustrated series that extends the firm’s curatorial strengths, it still offers option value for further variants while carrying costs are relatively manageable in the firm’s catalog business.
A reissued jazz vinyl LP fits the firm’s genre-broadening strategy and collector audience, so despite being a single title it still merits staying on the market unless sales clearly disappoint.
A multi-disc box set is comparatively expensive and bulky to keep in stock, so once sales information from the initial release period is known the option value falls and dropping becomes more likely.

This 2019 compilation CD received weaker website prominence than the other launches, suggesting lower commitment and lower remaining option value relative to competing projects in the firm’s expanding catalog.
